items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 72:1
items.html: You already know the difference between the Partzufim of AK and the Partzufim of Atzilut: the Partzufim of AK are the aspect of the five Partzufim of the light of Hochma, while the Partzufim of Atzilut are the five Partzufim in the illumination of Hochma within Hassadim, and not Hochma itself. This is because the matter of the five Partzufim of Atzilut is only to complete the aspect below the Tabur of AK, which is the aspect of MA and BON, namely ZON, whose entire correction is only the aspect of the illumination of Hochma within Hassadim, like the aspect of ZON of direct light. You also know that there are two bestowals to Keter: from HGT it is Hochma, and from NHY it bestows Hassadim, as above in Answer 149. Therefore ZAT of Atzilut cannot come out from the coupling of kissing, which is the bestowal of Hochma, but must come out from the aspect of NHY, which is the coupling of the Yesodot, from where comes the bestowal of Hassadim. Yet they also need the coupling of kissing, since ZON cannot come out in the bestowal of Hochma without true GAR preceding them, just as a body cannot come out without a head. For once the light of Hochma is revealed in GAR, ZON can receive the illumination of Hochma from them. (947, Sub Header, “And Now”)
